description: The OSF deposit compares integrated urban wastewater performance under four sewer-control settings: uncontrolled operation, model-predictive control, outlet-valve-only control and constrained-valve control. The last setting has ten replicate simulations. This resource is provided by Unknown depositor; OSF project 92z8d. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC0-1.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These are generated study results; the deposit does not establish wider reuse or a validated operational deployment. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
